text:
Looks like pineapple chunks (about 20 pieces) with a couple of small pieces of apple or peach skin and a bit of white yogurt or cream.

Estimated mass: each chunk weighs about 7 g, so 20 chunks come to about 140 g. The small extras add about 10 g, for a total of about 150 g.

Pineapple is about 50 kcal per 100 g, so 150 g is about 75 kcal. That gives roughly 75 kcal in total.
